rows.label: tlk502201_msg0001
rows.name: Mo-mo?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0002
rows.name: What should we ask?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0003
rows.name: Ask about Salvager Ranks

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0004
rows.name: Ask if Mochimochi needs any help

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0005
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo?!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0006
rows.name:
So you know about that? You're quite
the sly one, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0007
rows.name:
Mochimochi has watched Salvagers since
birth, so I can judge their skill
really well, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0008
rows.name:
Mochimochi's motto is fairness and
impartiality, mo. That's why I rank
Salvagers, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0009
rows.name:
Hmm... So you want Mochimochi to rank
you, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0010
rows.name: All right, I'll do it, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0011
rows.name:
But I want the ranking fee paid in
cash, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0012
rows.name:
Mo?! Why are you looking at me with
such scorn, mo?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0013
rows.name:
B-but! When you rank up, you get a
reward as a present, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0014
rows.name: Come on, pay the fee generously, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0015
rows.name: Pay 100G?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0016
rows.name: Thanks for your business, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0017
rows.name:
Let's see... Promising Youngster Rex's
Salvager Rank is...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0018
rows.name: Congratulations! Rank E, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0019
rows.name:
If you ask Mochimochi, you're still a
fledgling, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0020
rows.name: A fledgling among fledglings, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0021
rows.name:
But I promised, so here's your
present, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0022
rows.name:
Do lots more salvaging, then come back
to Mochimochi, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0023
rows.name:
Then I'll rank you again, mo! For a
fee!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0024
rows.name: Not even ranked, mo?!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0025
rows.name:
You're a young Salvager known around
the Avaritia Trading Company, yet you
haven't been salvaging lately, mo?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0026
rows.name:
Haa... I can't understand trying to
get ranked with skills like that,
mo...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0027
rows.name: Come back when you're ready, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0028
rows.name:
Mo-mo?! I never expected you to choose
that, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0029
rows.name:
If you don't pay, I won't rank you,
mo! You understand that, mo?!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0051
rows.name:
I'm not short on money, my family is
healthy, and I have no problems, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0052
rows.name:
If I had to name one thing,
Meroro-san's son and my son are good
friends, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0053
rows.name:
The lazybones disease might rub off on
him, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0101
rows.name:
Want me to rank your Salvager skills,
mo?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0102
rows.name:
I'm looking forward to seeing how much
Rex has improved, mooo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0103
rows.name: Then please pay the fee, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0104
rows.name:
Lastly, as promised, here's your
rank-up gift, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0201
rows.name:
Want me to rank your Salvager skills,
mo?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0202
rows.name:
I'm looking forward to seeing how much
Rex has improved, mooo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0203
rows.name: Then please pay the fee, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0204
rows.name:
Let's see... Fledgling Salvager Rex's
rank is...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0205
rows.name:
Congratulations! You've reached Rank
D, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0206
rows.name:
Looks like you're getting the hang of
it, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0207
rows.name:
By the way, Bahn-sama is Rank D too,
mo. His Salvager skill was actually
pretty average, mo...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0208
rows.name:
Do lots more salvaging, then come back
to Mochimochi, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0209
rows.name:
Then I'll rank you again, mo! For a
fee!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0210
rows.name:
And finally, here's your rank-up gift,
mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0211
rows.name:
Hmm... Sadly, it looks like ranking up
is still a ways off, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0212
rows.name:
Your rank changes based on the types
of treasure chests you get from
salvaging, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0213
rows.name:
Do lots more salvaging, then come back
to Mochimochi, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0214
rows.name:
Mo-mo?! You noticed I raised the price
a little, mo?!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0215
rows.name:
But unless you pay, I won't rank you,
mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0301
rows.name:
Let's see... Bahn-Class Salvager Rex's
rank is...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0302
rows.name:
Congratulations! You've reached Rank
C, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0303
rows.name:
Mochimochi's father is Rank C too, mo.
Catching up at your age means you're
very skilled, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0304
rows.name:
Rank C is actually quite high among
Salvagers in the Avaritia Trading
Company, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0305
rows.name:
You can get rich enough from salvaging
to eat mushrooms every day, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0401
rows.name:
Let's see... Mushroom-Feast Salvager
Rex's rank is...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0402
rows.name:
Congratulations! You've reached Rank
B, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0403
rows.name:
In Mochimochi's whole life, I've only
seen two Rank B Salvagers, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0404
rows.name:
Bahn-sama's father, and Mochimochi's
great-grandmother, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0405
rows.name:
My great-grandmother was incredibly
skilled. Every salvage brought back a
shining white treasure chest, mo...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0406
rows.name:
She's passed away now, so she's known
as a legendary Salvager, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0501
rows.name:
Let's see... Legendary Salvager Rex's
rank is...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0502
rows.name:
Congratulations! You've reached Rank
A, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0503
rows.name:
In all Mochimochi's life, I've never
seen a Salvager as skilled as Rex, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0504
rows.name:
You have a divine aura, mo. You're so
shiny it's dazzling, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0505
rows.name:
And now I feel an irresistible urge to
worship you, mo...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0506
rows.name: Blessed, mo... Blessed, mo...

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0507
rows.name:
It's worth celebrating, but sadly
there's no rank above Rank A, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0508
rows.name: Lastly, here's your rank-up gift, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0509
rows.name:
Now I'm very honored that you let
Mochimochi rank you, mo.

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0510
rows.name: Thank you, mo!

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0511
rows.name: Pay 200G?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0512
rows.name: Pay 500G?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0513
rows.name: Pay 1000G?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0514
rows.name: Pay 2000G?

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0515
rows.name: Pay

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0516
rows.name: Don't pay

rows.label: tlk502201_msg0601
rows.name:
Mochimochi doesn't feel like talking
unless there's a Salvager around,
mo...
